# Why did my QuickBooks chart of accounts import skip accounts?

> Free QuickBooks Online chart of accounts import CSV checker: unknown account types, blank detail types, duplicate names and numbers, sub-accounts before their parent, balances on income and expense accounts and missing as-of dates, with line numbers and safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
